title: The Crew: The Quest for Planet Nine
subtitle: A cooperative trick-taking odyssey across deep space with limited communication
tagline: In the silent depths of space, silent teamwork is your only lifeline
loreSummary: Astronomers have detected gravitational anomalies at the edge of our solar system pointing to a mysterious ninth planet. As an elite astronaut crew, you must coordinate silent trick-taking maneuvers through 50 escalating missions to chart the unknown.
keyFeatures: Cooperative trick-taking mechanics with strictly limited communication
50 sequential narrative missions scaling from basic drills to extreme hazards
Task card distribution requiring precise trick sequence and card allocation
Emergency distress signal mechanic and customizable difficulty modifiers

crew_training_run.name: Astronaut Training & Lunar Arc
crew_training_run.description: Missions 1 to 20 covering ground training, launch, Earth orbit, and the lunar slingshot maneuvers.

crew_full_expedition.name: Full Expedition to Planet Nine
crew_full_expedition.description: The complete 50-mission journey from Earth simulator drills all the way to the discovery of Planet Nine.

crew_master_astronaut.name: Master Astronaut Campaign
crew_master_astronaut.description: All 50 missions played with minimal distress signals, retry allowances, and bonus commander challenges.

milestones.title: Astronaut Flight Certification
milestones.phase: Phase I — Ground Simulations & Team Synchronization
milestones.description: Finalize pre-flight drills, zero-gravity coordination, and establish crew drift compatibility.

milestones.title: Lunar Slingshot & Orbital Departure
milestones.phase: Phase II — Earth Orbit & Lunar Transit
milestones.description: Break free of Earth-Moon gravitational pull and initiate long-range sensor calibration into deep space.

milestones.title: The Asteroid Belt & Sensor Dead Zones
milestones.phase: Phase III — Deep Space Transit & Extreme Malfunctions
milestones.description: Navigate high-density debris fields and hazardous solar storms while radio communications face severe disruption.

milestones.title: Gravitational Anomaly at the Outer Edge
milestones.description: Pinpoint unusual gravitational wave oscillations in the frozen dark beyond the known planetary orbits.

milestones.title: Discovery of Planet Nine
milestones.phase: Phase V — The Edge of the Solar System
milestones.description: Execute the definitive cooperative series of maneuvers to locate, confirm, and chart humanity's long-lost ninth planet.
